basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview/written test for the post of RA/SRA at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (A Central University), Lucknow will be held on 3 December 2026 at 11:30 AM onward in the Department of Information Technology. The post is in a Council of Science and Technology, Uttar Pradesh sponsored project and carries a fixed stipend/fellowship/salary of Rs. 28,000/-; applications on plain paper go by email to the project's Co-P.I., Dr. Alka, at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The single post advertised is RA/SRA, to work on the project named above. The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA/MSc. (IT). Knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Fog Computing is listed as a desirable qualification, "if any". The upper age limit is 28 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GoI rules. The post carries a Fixed Stipend/Fellowship/Salary amount of Rs. 28,000/-. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project on completion of 02 years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Write the application on plain paper giving your name, permanent and correspondence address, names of father and mother, telephone number and email id. Give details of your educational career, starting from High School or equivalent. Add details of any research or other experience, if any. Attach self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates. Send the application so that it reaches the Co-P.I. of the project, Dr. Alka, Department of Information Technology, Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow, on email id [email protected] . Attend the Walk-In-Interview/Written Test on 3 December 2026 at 11:30 AM onward at the Department of Information Technology.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The notice lists the selection stage as "Walk-In-Interview/Written Test", held on 3 December 2026 from 11:30 AM onward at the Department of Information Technology. No TA/DA will be paid if a candidate is called for an interview.
